content_sections.heading: CSIR IHBT – Quick Summary
content_sections.text: Who is recruiting? CSIR-Institute of Himalayan Bioresource Technology (CSIR-IHBT), Palampur Which posts? Senior PAT, Project Associate PAT-I, Project Associate PAT-II, Project Assistant-I (PA-I) How many vacancies? 44 Positions Who can apply? content_sections.heading: CSIR IHBT Project Associate Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The 44 posts break down as follows: The posts sit under these projects: Deciphering the Stress-induced and Chloroplast-triggered programmed cell death in Arabidopsis thaliana (GAP 0340) Genome editing for crop improvement (GE-Crop) (MMP025301) CSIR Aroma 4.0: Driving Sustainable Rural Empowerment and Entrepreneurship through Aromatic Plants (MMP025304) Smart Village (MMP045201) Determinants of Attitudes Toward Novel Agrotechnologies (IHP002414) The notification notes that the number of candidates finally selected may differ from the advertised number, depending on performance in the selection process.

content_sections.heading: CSIR IHBT Eligibility Criteria and Qualification
content_sections.text: Eligibility depends on the position code. The notification lists one or more essential qualifications for each code, plus desirable experience that is preferred but not the stated minimum. Candidates whose results are awaited are not eligible for the interview. All degrees must be from a recognized university. Experience required for Senior PAT and PAT-II must be in R&D in industrial or academic institutions, or in science and technology organizations and scientific activities and services. Check the full desirable-experience column in the official PDF before attending.

content_sections.heading: CSIR IHBT Salary
content_sections.text: The stipend is consolidated per month and paid along with HRA. Higher PAT-I stipend: For codes 17002, 17007, 17012, 17016, 17020, 17022 and 17024, candidates who qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET (including lectureship/assistant professorship) or GATE, or a national-level exam by Central Government departments such as DBT/DST or equivalent, get Rs. 31,000 + HRA. Others for those codes get Rs. 25,000 + HRA. The notification states the HRA rate as 10% for codes 17002 and 17022 and gives it as "+ HRA" elsewhere.

content_sections.heading: CSIR IHBT Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Selection Committee may select candidates either by a direct interview or by an objective test (multiple-choice questions) followed by an interview on the same day. The final decision rests with the Director, CSIR-IHBT. Request for online interview will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR IHBT Project Associate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Check the position code that matches your qualification and age. Download the prescribed application form from www.ihbt.res.in . Fill it in and affix a recent coloured passport-size photograph, cross-signed. Attach self-attested photocopies of age, qualification and experience certificates. Apply separately for each position code if you want to apply for more than one. Reach CSIR-IHBT, Palampur by 09:30 AM on the interview date for your code, with the original certificates. No travelling allowance is paid. There is no online application in this notification. Candidates apply offline by attending the walk-in interview with the filled form. The engagement is temporary and co-terminus with the project tenure or 6 years, whichever is earlier. It gives no right or claim to a regular post at CSIR or CSIR-IHBT. Performance is reviewed every six months, and unsatisfactory staff may be terminated. Project end dates range from 31.03.2027 to 31.03.2029, depending on the project.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSIR-IHBT Palampur has issued Advertisement No. 17/2026 to recruit 44 temporary positions including Senior PAT, Project Associate, and Project Assistant under various research projects through walk-in interviews.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CSIR IHBT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 44 vacancies are advertised across various position codes.

faq.question: Q3. What are the walk-in interview dates?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews are scheduled from 16 October 2026 to 27 October 2026 depending on the respective position code.

faq.question: Q4. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report by 09.30 AM. Candidates reporting after 10.00 AM will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the venue for the interview?
faq.answer: The interviews will be held at CSIR-IHBT, Palampur, Himachal Pradesh.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for more than one position code?
faq.answer: Yes, but candidates must submit separate application forms for each position code.

faq.question: Q8. Are online interviews allowed?
faq.answer: No, requests for online interviews will not be entertained under any circumstances.
